newsitem.title: UK: Rank AGM clears way for future buy back.
newsitem.headline: Rank AGM clears way for future buy back.

text.p: Rank Group Plc shareholders approved a move on Thursday to give the company the right to purchase up to 10 percent of its Ordinary shares.
A resolution clearing the way for a future share repurchase was passed at the British leisure company's annual general meeting.
The company has said it would exercise the power only if it was in the best interests of shareholders and could be expected to boost earnings per share.

There has been market speculation that Rank might fund a repurchase from the proceeds of the planned sale of its remaining 20 percent stake in Rank Xerox, its office equipment joint venture with Xerox Corp.
The stake is valued in Rank's accounts at 930 million stg. Rank has said it does not intend to hold on to the stake but has set no timetable for its disposal.
